text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pendidikan (Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2019) 2018.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi pendidikan bagi

tahun 2019.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2019 adalah sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Kumpulan A Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan

di Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu dan

Johor

 1 Januari 2019 hingga 21 Mac 2019

 31 Mac 2019 hingga 23 Mei 2019

Penggal Kedua

 9 Jun 2019 hingga 8 Ogos 2019

 18 Ogos 2019 hingga 21 November 2019

Kumpulan B Penggal Pertama

Semua institusi pendidikan di Perlis,

Pulau Pinang, Perak, Selangor,

Negeri Sembilan, Melaka, Pahang,

Sabah, Sarawak, Wilayah Persekutuan

Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan

Labuan dan Wilayah Persekutuan

Putrajaya

 2 Januari 2019 hingga 22 Mac 2019

 1 April 2019 hingga 24 Mei 2019

 Penggal Kedua

 10 Jun 2019 hingga 9 Ogos 2019

 19 Ogos 2019 hingga 22 November 2019

Dibuat 28 Disember 2018

[K [KPMSP.100-1/7/1; PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. MASZLEE BIN MALIK

Menteri Pendidikan

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2019)

REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the

Education Act 1996 [Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions for

the year 2019.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2019 shall be

as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Group A First Term

All educational institutions in Kedah,

Kelantan, Terengganu and Johore

 1 January 2019 to 21 March 2019

 31 March 2019 to 23 May 2019

Second Term

 9 June 2019 to 8 August 2019

 18 August 2019 to 21 November 2019

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2019) Regulations 2018.

Group B First Term

All educational institutions in Perlis,

Penang, Perak, Selangor,

Negeri Sembilan, Malacca, Pahang,

Sabah, Sarawak, Federal Territory of

Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of

Labuan and Federal Territory

of Putrajaya

 2 January 2019 to 22 March 2019

 1 April 2019 to 24 May 2019

 Second Term

 10 June 2019 to 9 August 2019

 19 August 2019 to 22 November 2019

Made 28 December 2018

[KPMSP.100-1/7/1; PN(PU2)569/XIV]

DR. MASZLEE BIN MALIK

Minister of Education
